raw_metrics.cell_type: putative cell class of the lab's 2019 buzcode CellClass.cellinfo.mat (pE: putative excitatory, pI: putative inhibitory, from waveform and firing features); 'not classified' for units not in that file
raw_metrics.lratio: L-ratio of the cluster (GeneralInfo.mat lratio, from the lab's calcClusterQuality on the .fet features); NaN for units not in the cell list
raw_metrics.mahalanobis_distance: isolation distance of the cluster (GeneralInfo.mat mahD); NaN for units not in the cell list
raw_metrics.isi_index: ISI index of the cluster (GeneralInfo.mat isiIx): fraction of refractory-period violations; NaN for units not in the cell list
raw_metrics.in_lab_cell_list: the unit is in the lab's cell list of the session (Analysis/SpikeData.mat), the units of the lab's analyses; the paper's exact selection of 720 thalamic and 357 post-subicular cells is not recorded
